description:
Revokes a `MEMBER`'s access to one company. Their grants over the account's other companies are left as they were.

Endpoint: DELETE /v1/accounts/{account_id}/members/{member_id}/grants/{company_id}

account_id.description: Your own account, or an account you provisioned. It — not the credential — decides which account the operation acts on; a `403` is returned when you do not reach it, the same response an account that does not exist gets.

company_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the company within the account.

name: beel_delete_member_grant
